content: No, you should never use drain cleaner or any hazardous chemical for cooking or food coloring. Drain cleaners contain toxic and corrosive substances that are extremely dangerous to ingest and can cause severe harm or even be fatal. To safely color your waffles blue, you should use food coloring specifically designed for culinary purposes. You can typically find blue food coloring in liquid, gel, or powder form at supermarkets or baking supply stores. Always prioritize food safety when preparing meals.
